qualification_carried_forward.explanation: the counters show the limit was reached once and no kill occurred. Reclaim of clean page cache from the 567 MB output file is the explanation most consistent with that and with the anonymous set peaking well below the cap. It was NOT directly instrumented, so it is the supported reading rather than a conclusively established cause. Other contributions to the cgroup total were not measured separately.
qualification_carried_forward.headroom_at_peak: ZERO in cgroup terms. The peak equalled the cap.
qualification_carried_forward.practical_consequence: the margin is not anonymous headroom. A workload that grew the anonymous set materially could still fail.
